newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads man for killing relative.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads man for killing relative.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Saudi man for shooting dead a relative after a dispute, Saudi state-run television said.
An interior ministry statement carried by the television did not say how the two men were related.
The beheading, near the capital Riyadh, raised to 65 the number of people executed in the conservative Islamic kingdom so far this year.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
